chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] For all m,s>=1: Ecal(m,s+1) >= Ecal(m+1,s) (M_merge >= L_lift). Evidence: 239 exact rows, 0 violations; support, never a theorem.

chain.link: L2 iterate to fixed-resolution decay with rate
chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] Needed: explicit Ecal(m,r) <= delta(m) -> 0 at fixed r with stated rate. Missing: naive iteration gives only Ecal(m,r)>=...>=Ecal(m+r-1,1)>=0 and Ecal(m,r)<=...<=Ecal(1,m+r-1)=2^(m+r-2) [PROOF+EXACT COMPUTATION]; fixed-r column r=2 oscillates 2,4,4,8,31/3,38/5,... so no fixed-r decay follows [FAIL].

chain.link: L3 top-bit control to full mixing
chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] Needed: J_r (top-bit projection) upgrades to total-variation / all-frequency uniformity mod 2^r plus 3-adic control. Blocked [PROOF]: programme proved uniform exponential Fourier decay IMPOSSIBLE (exact coefficient >=1/2) and proved no mod-N refinement of the merge side exists (A7).

chain.link: L4 census uniformity to typical-orbit control
chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] Needed: transfer lemma from census bounds to density-one orbit control (Tao-type almost-all boundedness). No programme-side lemma with quantifiers exists; literature version uses different quantitative machinery [JUDGEMENT].

chain.link: L5 typical behaviour excludes divergent orbits
chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] Needed: density-one control rules out an unbounded non-cycling orbit. Ceiling B1 [JUDGEMENT]: one orbit has density zero, so almost-all theorems are logically compatible with one divergent orbit.

chain.link: L6 typical behaviour excludes nontrivial cycles
chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] Needed: statistical decay constrains the exact return equation H^p(x)=x. Method mismatch [JUDGEMENT]: cycles are Diophantine objects; no statistical hypothesis here constrains exact return; no bridge formulated.

chain.link: L7 finite windows trap one infinite orbit
chain.statement: [CONJECTURE] Needed: bounds uniform over all scales jointly control a single fixed infinite orbit. Ceiling B2/CP18 [JUDGEMENT]: finite-window data cannot separate per-pattern realisability from one joint realisation.

chain.link: L8 assembly (no cycles + no divergence => Collatz)
chain.statement: [PROOF] Classical pigeonhole: an orbit never hitting 1 is infinite; bounded+infinite repeats (cycle), never-repeating in N is unbounded; excluding both leaves reaching 1.

endpoint_verdict: [JUDGEMENT] The chain terminates at an 'almost all' statement that Tao (2019/2022) already owns, not at Collatz. Even perfect one-step mixing needs three unformulated upgrades (fixed-resolution decay with rate; top-bit to full-distribution control against a proved >=1/2 Fourier obstruction; census-to-density transfer) before reaching 'almost all', and two known ceilings (B1 measure-zero escape; B2 finite-information wall) block the road from 'almost all' to 'all'. Best achievable outcome without a new per-orbit idea is a weaker redundant special case; retargeting is the defensible first-class conclusion.
honest_translation: [EXACT COMPUTATION] Ecal(4,3)=40/3 says: the 8 odd starts below 16, run 4 H-steps, land at 1,2,1,13,17,20,8,80 with odd-counts 2,2,1,3,3,3,2,4, and the weighted top-bit discrepancy mod 8 is 40/3. [EXACT COMPUTATION] Ecal(5,2)=31/3 says: the 16 odd starts below 32, run 5 H-steps, land at 2,1,2,20,26,10,4,40,5,17,2,20,22,71,26,242, with weighted top-bit discrepancy mod 4 of 31/3. [JUDGEMENT] '239 rows, 0 violations' says only that this shifting-resolution non-increase held for 239 small censuses; it says nothing about any larger integer, longer orbit, uniformity in general (a finite table is never a uniform theorem), or the existence of a cycle or divergent orbit.
weakest_link: [JUDGEMENT] Weakest link is the statistical-to-single-orbit passage (the lead's step 3), fusing Links 5+7. [CONJECTURE] Needed Transfer Thesis: there exist fixed r>=1, delta(m)->0, c>0 such that (for all large m, Ecal(m,r)<=delta(m)) implies every H-orbit reaches 1; equivalently, a counterexample orbit x0 forces lim sup Ecal(m,r)>=c(x0)>0. [FAIL] No statement of that shape, with explicit quantifiers, exists anywhere in the programme -- step 3 is a hope, not a conjecture -- and to my knowledge none exists in the literature either; Tao's results have deliberately opposite (density-one) quantifiers, and B1+B2 explain why no Ecal-type statistical hypothesis alone can yield the stronger quantifiers.
what_target_buys: [PROOF] Assuming Ecal(m,s+1)>=Ecal(m+1,s) for all m,s, iteration gives only Ecal(m,r)>=Ecal(m+1,r-1)>=...>=Ecal(m+r-1,1)>=0 and Ecal(m,r)<=...<=Ecal(1,m+r-1)=2^(m+r-2) [EXACT COMPUTATION]. So each diagonal carries a bounded monotone sequence converging to an unidentified limit L>=0 with no rate. [FAIL] Fixed-resolution decay does not follow: exact column r=2 reads 2,4,4,8,31/3,38/5,... (oscillates). [JUDGEMENT] One monotonicity step therefore buys zero orbit theorems; a Tao-type corollary would additionally need an explicit rate delta(m)->0, full-distribution (not top-bit) control, stratum-to-density reweighting, and a stopping-time transfer with union bounds over ~log X scales -- none of which follows.
